title: New Zealand archives reveal Kaikoura cover-up and squid boat explanation

tellings.quote: I discovered that there'd been this release of the New Zealand archives in about 2011.

plain: Government files released by New Zealand around 2011 shed light on the 1978 Kaikoura sightings, lights seen and filmed off New Zealand's coast, including the official explanation that the lights were squid fishing boats, which he presents as a cover-up. The journalist Ross Coulthart says he discovered this archive release himself while researching the case. If so, the official story about Kaikoura would have been shaped to explain the sightings away.
